scope: Routing groups for reconstruction review, not package boundaries or claims of a common abstraction. First matching selector assigns each module. Per-module correspondence supplies the source contract; imports preserve cross-group dependencies.

families.title: Public aggregation and audit counterexamples
families.rationale: Reference import ownership and audit failure cases; no mathematical package is proposed.

families.title: Finite numeral and floating arithmetic
families.rationale: Interpretation, normalization and rounding error contracts must preserve their exact arithmetic model.

families.title: Partial and demand-sensitive lists
families.rationale: Domain observations, demand and fusion have different hypotheses from finite total list folds.

families.title: Finite list folds, scans and compression
families.rationale: Sequence observations connect folds, scans, context concatenation and run compression; use standard List results where contracts agree.

families.title: Asymptotic, recurrence and amortized reasoning
families.rationale: Operation-count interpretations and growth arguments are reusable independently of the algorithm whose cost they bound.

families.title: Array and tree representations of sequences
families.rationale: Indexing, flattening and end-operation observations justify representation changes.

families.title: Ordered search trees, sets and grid search
families.rationale: Search, split/join and order invariants support consumers; grid query lower bounds remain separate contracts.

families.title: Sorting, ordered merging and permutation observations
families.rationale: Permutation, sortedness, stability and comparison traces must remain distinct; include search-derived sorting as another realization.

families.title: Rank, extrema and finite selection
families.rationale: Rank semantics relate implementations; adversary and recurrence bounds retain their own quantifiers.

families.title: Coin enumeration, greedy choice and tabulation
families.rationale: Coin multiplicity and optimum semantics connect greedy, thinned and tabulated implementations without assuming every denomination system is canonical.

families.title: Weighted tree construction and priority queues
families.rationale: Fringe/weight observations connect enumerations and greedy builders; queue laws serve independent consumers.

families.title: Connectivity partitions and disjoint-set representations
families.rationale: Partition and request-history observations connect list and array stores without equating representative identities.

families.title: Graph paths, spanning forests and tours
families.rationale: Independent graph/path semantics support minimum proofs; shortest paths, forests and tours are separate optimization domains.

families.title: Dominance coverage and candidate pruning
families.rationale: Coverage, origin membership and objective compatibility support multiple optimization consumers.

families.title: Capacity-constrained selection and frontier refinement
families.rationale: Feasible sublists, fractional boundaries and integer/array variants require explicit domain adapters.

families.title: Layered path optimization
families.rationale: Layer sequence semantics preserve failure and empty-input behavior; endpoint shortest paths are a different specification.

families.title: Subsequence and edit-distance optimization
families.rationale: Independent embeddings/edit scripts connect recursive, cached and frontier representations; edit weights remain explicit.

families.title: Contiguous segment optimization
families.rationale: Enumeration, prefix/scan observations and maxima must agree about empty segments and index occurrences.

families.title: Ordered partition and boundary optimization
families.rationale: Partition admissibility and objective laws support bank-transfer and paragraph clients; closure and tie directions are local assumptions.

families.title: Numeric and shuttle recurrences
families.rationale: Recurrence semantics connect streams, memo tables and independent shuttle objectives; no common scheduler is assumed.

families.title: Alphabetic tree greedy optimization
families.rationale: Fringe-preserving reductions and reconstruction connect the optimum to list and AVL executions.

families.title: Interval and bracketing dynamic programming
families.rationale: Fixed-fringe tree semantics connect exhaustive, recursive, cached and array outputs; monotonicity is weaker than associativity.

families.title: Finite constraint counting and queens representations
families.rationale: Enumeration, masks, propagation and certificate multiplicity require explicit agreement; stock n16 proof remains open.

families.title: Arithmetic expression enumeration
families.rationale: Expression meaning and bounded enumeration justify counting/search; rounding models belong to the floating family.

families.title: Sliding-puzzle transitions, parity and certificates
families.rationale: Board encodings, reachability parity and minimum-path witnesses connect this concrete search family; generated proof chunks retain their owning certificate.

families.title: Geometric path safety, metrics and warehouse search
families.rationale: Ray and obstacle safety, rounded metrics and finite graph realization need explicit geometry-to-search contracts.

families.title: Rush-hour geometry and hierarchical planning
families.rationale: Vehicle encodings, macro moves and plan expansion connect geometric legality to the planning search consumer.

families.title: Finite puzzle transition realizations
families.rationale: Conservation, move legality and finite-state encoding obligations remain per client; shared search machinery is accepted only after proving each transition adapter.

families.title: Transition search, planning and heuristic minima
families.rationale: Independent path and completed-run semantics connect queues, visited stores and planners; fuel, no goal and success remain distinct.
